description: The Folders window lists the data folders under the Epicenter folder root and opens each with the page's own engine. Listing permits the window into each folder's scope; the folder plugin then grants it the directory, reads and changes it, and runs the folder's Git itself. It also installs, approves, updates, and opens installed apps (ADR-0540). The window listens for the folder plugin's change event, epicenter-folder://changed, and for the shell's epicenter://data-folders-changed, sent when the list of data folders may have changed.
